title: 验证卷 #3 · 不规则分词 / the number of 单三
topic: IELTS 话题语境变式（第三轮）
goal: 收尾剩余两个点：①不规则动词的过去分词（rise→risen 第三次错，这次连 grow/increase 一起考）②'the number of / the proportion of + 复数名词 → has' 单三一致。全对即过关。

questions.prompt: Since 2020, the number of electric vehicles on the road ____ (rise) sharply.
questions.explanation: 双考点：①since + 时间点 → 现在完成时；②the number of + 复数名词，主语核心是 the number（单数）→ has；③rise-rose-risen。

questions.prompt: Since the app launched, its user base ____ (grow) to ten million.
questions.explanation: since + 过去时间点 → has + 过去分词；grow-grew-grown，user base 是单数主语。

questions.prompt: The proportion of online shoppers ____ (increase) steadily since 2015.
questions.explanation: the proportion of + 复数名词，主语核心是 the proportion（单数）→ has；increase 规则动词 → increased。

questions.prompt: The number of students who apply for this course every year ____ increasing.
questions.explanation: the number of + 复数名词 → 单数谓语 is。注意区分：a large number of + 复数名词 → are（那是另一条规则，别混）。

questions.prompt: One of the most common reasons for traffic accidents ____ (be) driver distraction.
questions.explanation: one of + 复数名词 → 单数谓语 is（上卷已对，这题巩固）。
